draft.subject: Bonds are 10.0% of your portfolio against a 15–40% range
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

Ahead of your next review, there is one thing I would like to raise. Under the Balanced Growth approach we agreed for your portfolio, bonds are meant to be between 15% and 40% of it, with 25% as the aim. Today they are 10.0%, which is 5.0 points below the lower end.

It is not a loss and nothing has gone wrong; the portfolio is simply carrying a little more risk than the shape you signed up to. As this is an advisory portfolio, the decisions are yours, and I would rather you heard it from me than found it on a statement.

What I would suggest is that we either bring the bond portion back into range, or you tell me you are comfortable as it is and I record that on your file. Both are fine; leaving it undecided is not.

Could I call you before the review to talk it through?
